name: Caffeine-Induced Heart Attack
source:
Lydia, soda connoisseur, stumbled onto the perfect living specimen... a soda that is also a girl! Will she partake in the forbidden juices within that fleshy body? Or fall disastrously in love with the soul inside?

[From [url=https://paintedhouses.itch.io/caffeine-induced-heart-attack]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
汽水品鉴达人莉迪亚意外撞见了完美的活体标本……一罐同时也是美少女的汽水！她究竟会品尝那具鲜活肉体中流淌的禁忌琼浆，还是无可救药地爱上寄宿其中的灵魂？

[摘自[url=https://paintedhouses.itch.io/caffeine-induced-heart-attack]itch.io[/url]]
